name: neobrutalism-progress-bars
title: Progress Bars
description: Neobrutalism-style progress bar components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and bold fill patterns. Perfect for loading states, completion tracking, and status indicators with a retro flair.
useWhen: Showing measurable completion, upload progress, or task advancement in a high-contrast interface.
Pairing a percentage or status label with a visual progress indicator.
avoidWhen: The process has no known completion amount — use an indeterminate loader.
Showing an unrelated status message with no progress value.
responsiveBehavior: Progress tracks fill available width while labels remain adjacent or stack below at narrow widths. Patterned fills remain visible without relying on color alone.
accessibility: Use a native progress element or role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.
Expose a readable progress value or status text.
